name: Aperture Selection
summary: Targets are acquired through a controllable aperture that balances precision and speed.
howItWorks: A cone runs from the eye through a circular aperture held in the hand. Moving the hand closer or farther widens or narrows the cone; the object best centred in it is selected.
advantages: Precise selection of small or distant objects.
limitations: Requires learning and can add extra adjustment steps.
